cases.scenario: Moved file route and helper fidelity
cases.expected: All 10 moved endpoints and their supporting helpers retain HEAD behavior modulo relocation and whitespace.
cases.evidence: Mechanical HEAD/current comparison found all 10 endpoint paths present; all nine inline async handler bodies matched after whitespace normalization. The upload route retained its handler reference and the HEAD/current uploadFilesHandler regions matched after whitespace normalization. Moved helper inventory: upload limits, permission/tree/concurrency helpers, workspace expansion, project containment validation, filename validation, and upload handler.

cases.scenario: Response contract strings and status behavior
cases.expected: Moved endpoints retain their error/message strings and HTTP status behavior.
cases.evidence: files-routes-contract exercised create/rename/delete/list/read/write, binary content (including preserved missing-binary 500), upload, browse, and create-folder success/error contracts; all assertions passed in each of three runs.

cases.expected: normalizeProjectPath, validateWorkspacePath, sanitizeLeafDirectoryName, and FORBIDDEN_WORKSPACE_PATHS equal HEAD utils implementations.
cases.evidence: TypeScript AST declaration comparison against git show HEAD:server/shared/utils.ts found no mismatch for all extracted workspace declarations; workspace-paths tests passed 3/3, including literal %2e%2e and '.' leaf-name behavior.

cases.expected: All existing utils imports of workspace symbols continue to resolve.
cases.evidence: Import search found existing consumers still import from '@/shared/utils.js'; utils.ts re-exports the five workspace symbols. npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json and -p server/tsconfig.json both exited 0.

cases.expected: Every moved route remains behind authenticateToken and rejects an unauthenticated password-mode request.
cases.evidence: All 10 router registrations include authenticateToken. Isolated HTTP harness with CHATMUX_AUTH=password issued unauthenticated requests to every route: each returned 401 with {error:'Access denied. No token provided.'}.

cases.expected: projectsStateMerge and liveRelayComposer preserve extracted behavior and component/hook public interfaces.
cases.evidence: HEAD/current declaration inspection found extraction-only relocation; useProjectsState and LiveRelayComposer retain their public imports/re-exports. projectsStateMerge and LiveRelayComposer tests passed 3/3.

cases.expected: New extraction edges create no cycle.
cases.evidence: BFS inspection of new edges found filesRoutes -> shared/database/auth containment modules with no path back to server/index; utils -> workspace-paths; useProjectsState -> projectsStateMerge; and LiveRelayComposer -> liveRelayComposer, each terminating in types/leaf modules. No new cycle found (pre-existing chat-run-registry cycle excluded).

cases.expected: files-routes-contract, workspace-paths, projectsStateMerge, and LiveRelayComposer tests are non-flaky across three consecutive runs.
cases.evidence: Three consecutive focused runs: backend pair 6/6 pass each run and frontend pair 6/6 pass each run; 36 total passing test executions, zero failures.
